notes.title: Update v1.1.0 - CG Gallery & More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
We've just released a new update for Velvet Bite: Softly, with Teeth! 

What's New:

[b]CG Gallery[/b]
You can now revisit and enjoy all the beautiful CGs you've unlocked in the game anytime! Relive those memorable moments in the gallery! ✨

[b]Ending Collection[/b]
We've added a new feature that allows you to keep track of and collect all the endings you've achieved! Try to unlock them all! 🏆

[b]Simplified Chinese Language Enhancement[/b]
We made improvements to the Simplified Chinese translation to provide a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience for our Chinese players! 
 
Thank you for supporting Velvet Bite: Softly, with Teeth!
Your feedback is greatly appreciated.

notes.title: Our LGBT+ vampire otome Velvet Bite: Softly, with Teeth is out now on Steam
notes.notes:
Our LGBT+ vampire otome game Velvet Bite: Softly, with Teeth is out now on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080899/0a31c1a3aa24a00c8e408afdf1ebd102b5078aed.jpg[/img]

Velvet Bite follows the nameable female protagonist who goes to a Halloween party only to find out that the guests are all secretly vampires. You'll have the option to romance 6 different love interests, half male and half female, with full voice acting for the love interests.

Features:
6 love interests - 3 male, 3 female
multiple languages to read the story in
multiple languages of voice acting for the love interests
lots of custom event graphics

Happy Valentine's Day~
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2894820/]Play it Now[/url]
